name: Sheshadri Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2009, Sheshadri Industries Ltd manufactures cotton, polyester, yarns, and readymade garments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) SIL manufactures and sells:
- Cotton yarn
- Blended polyester yarn
- Polyester yarn
b) Garment production:
The company produces ready-made garments for Men, Women, and Children.
c) Speciality yarn:
The product range includes:
- Mélange yarn
- Griddle yarn
- Doubled yarn
- Slub /fancy yarns

cons: Earnings include an other income of Rs.9.34 Cr.
